name: Ladder Capital Corp
summary:
Ladder Capital (LADR) reported earnings of $0.35 per share on revenue of $104.89 million for the third quarter ended September 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $0.21 per share on revenue of $59.50 million. The company beat consensus estimates by 66.67% while revenue grew 3.42% on a year-over-year basis.

Ladder Capital Corp is an internally-managed real estate investment trust. The Company invests in loans, securities and other interests in U.S. commercial real estate, with a focus on senior secured assets.
subject: Ladder Capital Beat Consensus Estimates

name: The Travelers Companies, Inc.
summary:
The Travelers Companies (TRV) reported earnings of $9.18 per share on revenue of $12.41 billion for the third quarter ended September 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $7.07 per share on revenue of $12.40 billion. The company beat consensus estimates by 29.84% while revenue fell 0.47% compared to the same quarter a year ago.

“We are pleased to report excellent third quarter results,” said Alan Schnitzer, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer. “It was another in a run of successful quarters, with very strong underwriting performance across all three segments and a record result from our investment portfolio. Core income for the quarter was $1.9 billion, or $9.18 per diluted share. Core return on equity for the quarter was 22.1%, bringing core return on equity over the last four quarters to 24.1%. Third quarter underwriting income of $1.4 billion pre-tax benefited from continued strong levels of underlying underwriting income and net favorable prior year development. Profitability was excellent on both a reported and underlying basis. The combined ratio improved to 86.8%, and the underlying combined ratio remained very strong at 84.1%.

Travelers Companies Inc through its subsidiaries provides commercial & personal property and casualty insurance products and services to businesses, government units, associations and individuals.
subject: The Travelers Companies Beat Consensus Estimates

name: Truist Financial Corporation
summary:
Truist Financial (TFC) reported earnings of $1.16 per share on revenue of $6.11 billion for the third quarter ended September 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $1.17 per share on revenue of $5.31 billion. The Earnings Whisper number was $1.16 per share. The company reported in-line with expectations while revenue fell 22.06% compared to the same quarter a year ago.

The company said in its earnings presentation it expects fourth quarter revenue of approximately $5.35 billion. The current consensus revenue estimate is $5.29 billion for the quarter ending December 31, 2026.

Truist Financial Corporation (NYSE: TFC) is a purpose-driven financial services company committed to inspire and build better lives and communities. Formed by the historic merger of equals of BB&T and SunTrust, Truist has leading market share in many high-growth markets in the country.
subject: Truist Financial Reported In-line with Expectations, Sees Revenue Above Estimates

subject: Citizens Financial Group Reported In-line with Expectations, Guides In-line
